sources.fullCitation: Jazz-Orchester mit Refraingesang. “Schade, daß Liebe ein Märchen ist.” Lied und Tango aus dem Richard Tauber-Tonfilm „Melodie der Liebe“; label credit “Jurmann – Kaper – Rotter”. Rot-Blau, Katalog-Nr. 9713, 1932. The description gives the matrix number 4070-1 and names Raimund Gessner as the refrain singer. Discographic detail as given in the uploader's description; the label is not shown in the YouTube upload.
